'''Torbel''' was a small [[City/Legends|village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], there was a mine located in the town that delivered raw [[damotite]] for [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd's]] [[damotite bioweapon]]. On a mission to destroy the bioweapon, The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived in the village on the run from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces, and posed as [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] looking for a new home in Torbel. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] helped prepare the village for a [[theta storm]], but the village was almost destroyed during a [[Battle of Lanteeb|Republic assault]] on the world in an effort to stop Durd.
